title: Google has been quietly giving away tools that do the exact work agencies and designers bills you
description:
Google has been quietly giving away tools that do the exact work agencies and designers bill you thousands for, and you've probably never opened a single one.

Five, all free. Pomelli: paste your website link and it reads your brand, then generates on-brand posts, ads and campaign ideas, the deliverable behind a monthly agency retainer. Opal: describe an automation in plain English and get a working mini-app you can share with a link, the job you'd otherwise pay a Make or n8n consultant for. Mixboard: Canva and Pinterest had a baby, an AI concepting board that generates and edits the imagery itself. Stitch: describe any interface and get the design plus the actual HTML and Tailwind code behind it. Antigravity: Google's own AI code editor, free on Mac, Windows and Linux.

The honest part: none of these fires your agency tomorrow. They hand you first drafts, and the free tiers have real limits. But the first draft is most of what the invoice was for. And this is half the list sitting on Google Labs.

Comment GOOGLE and I'll send you the links.
